messages:
Maya: Quick sync: post-launch grooming — we need to decide what goes into the 2-week micro-release. TL;DR: prioritize P0 customer hotpaths + regressions. Thoughts? @sam @leah
Sam: Agree. Can we use the 'impact x effort' matrix we used last quarter? I have a list of ~8 candidates.
Maya: Yep. Two guardrails: 1) any regression >= 3 customer reports => ship. 2) enhancements only if <= 3 dev-weeks or clear retention lift.
Jon: FYI SRE: we've seen 2 latency spikes tied to batching fallback — that's a regression flag. I'll add logs + a quick fix PR.
Sam: Share the list, I'll annotate effort (est. dev-days). Also propose we reserve one slot for a customer-requested UI tweak from Acme Corp.
Leah: Design can prototype the UI tweak in 2 days. Suggest we A/B it behind a flag. Also small UX bugs with major irritation score.
Maya: Plan: grooming tomorrow 11am PT. Deliverables: finalized matrix, owner for each item, acceptance criteria, rollout plan (canary %).
Sam: I'm ok to own the batching fallback fix. ETA: 3 days for fix + canary. PR: `fix/batching-fallback-guard`.
release-bot: created ticket PROD-389 for batching fallback fix and linked to the thread.
Jon: I'll create an incident trace and an on-call runbook for the canary rollback. If latency > 300ms p95 during canary, rollback.
Maya: Customer comms: I'll draft a short email for Acme + a release note blurb. Final ask: add metrics to the ticket: p95 latency, error-rate, and user sessions affected. :thumbsup:
